user.title: ICON-D2 PV-Prognose
user.description: Location and system. The forecast uses only the DWD ICON-D2 model (~2 km, ~48 h).

data_description.inverter_limit: Maximum AC power the forecast is clipped to. 0 = no limit.

string.title: PV string
string.description: One array with uniform tilt and orientation.

data_description.kwp: DC nameplate power of this string.
data_description.horizon: Pairs azimuth:elevation, e.g. 90:5, 135:25, 180:8, 250:15. Direct sunlight is blocked while the sun is below this line. Empty = free horizon.
data_description.efficiency: Fine tuning for this string only. 100 % = model unchanged.
data_description.damping_morning: Reduces the forecast for low morning sun (full at horizon, none above 30° sun elevation).
data_description.temp_coeff: From the module datasheet, typically −0.30 to −0.40 %/K.
data_description.albedo: Share of light reflected by the ground: grass 0.2, snow up to 0.8.

error.invalid_horizon: Invalid horizon profile. Format: azimuth:elevation, e.g. 90:5, 180:10

data_description.global_factor: Manual fine tuning of the whole system. 100 % = unchanged.
data_description.calibration: Compares yesterday's forecast with actual production every day and learns a correction factor (median of recent days).
data_description.calibration_entity: PV production meter in kWh/Wh with long-term statistics. Not grid export!
data_description.calibration_days: Number of recent days used for the factor.
